SEARCH
Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime

Record Class MavenBuildContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.runtime.MavenBuildContext
Record Components:
mavenExecutable - Maven executable used when the project has no wrapper.
javaHome - Java installation used for Maven, independently of the selected Minecraft executable.
activeProfiles - Explicitly requested active profile IDs, in request order.
inactiveProfiles - Explicitly disabled profile IDs.
userProperties - Retained version, compiler and LightKeeper input properties from the documented allowlist.
userSettings - Existing user settings file path, when selected.
globalSettings - Existing global settings file path, when selected.
userToolchains - Existing user toolchains file path, when selected.
globalToolchains - Existing global toolchains file path, when selected.
public record MavenBuildContext(String mavenExecutable, String javaHome, List<String> activeProfiles, List<String> inactiveProfiles, Map<String,String> userProperties, @Nullable String userSettings, @Nullable String globalSettings, @Nullable String userToolchains, @Nullable String globalToolchains) extends Record
Supported non-secret Maven invocation settings retained for a later native JUnit producer build. Repository credentials remain in Maven settings or the environment; arbitrary original CLI flags are not replayed.
